long_description:
**PIND OF AN ERA 🥂✨**

New year. Same culture. A whole new era.

Punjabi Underground is taking over **Bauhaus Houston** for a night built around Punjabi & Bollywood music, nonstop energy, and the perfect way to kick off 2027.

We’re bringing **Pind of an Era** to the lounge & patio with DJs spinning everything from Punjabi anthems and Bollywood favorites to the tracks that keep the night moving.

Come dressed like you’re stepping into your next era — **Dress to Impress.**

📍 Bauhaus Houston 

📅 January 2, 2027 

⏰ 10 PM – 2 AM 

🥂 21+ Only

**One last night before the next chapter.**

Presented by **Punjabi Underground**

Tickets are limited — secure yours and meet us at Pind of an Era.
